briefdescription.para: Check if a certain PLD Device is a valid device.

detaileddescription.para:
Qualification for a device to be called valid is:
Should have a structure allocated
Should have a valid existing parent (to prevent broken trees, as only 1 tree can exist). Exception is for PLD_0 because it's the root of the tree
